topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I found a time capsule today, tucked away under the gnarled roots of the old oak tree in the backyard. The wood was weathered, the metal tarnished, but there it was, a piece of history I couldn’t recall planting. As I pried it open, a rush of emotions washed over me with the scent of the earth and old memories. Inside, there were letters, photographs, and trinkets, each item a whisper from a forgotten afternoon. I marveled at the faces, now more familiar than the day they were captured. The capsule held not just relics but a basket of time, tenderly preserved, waiting to be rediscovered and cherished once more.
